notes.title: The final content update
notes.content:
Added a new kid at the playground. And now you can kick a sitting kohai.

It was the final content update. I'll add Korean translation to new dialogues soon, and will try to fix some bugs.

That's it.

notes.title: A new girl for romance
notes.content: You can now romance a new girl. Starting point at casino (there's an option for her to appear).

notes.title: New girl's quest is added
notes.content: Added a new girl's quest. Starting point at karaoke.

notes.title: Small update. You can now beat pool players if you lose to them
notes.content: You can now beat pool players if you lose to them.

notes.title: You can play with any npc (except the clerk) at billiards now
notes.content: You can play with any npc (except the clerk) at billiards now.

notes.title: New features added: penalties for beating passerby, eat/drink at home.
notes.content:
Added penalties for beating passerby (and some benefits as well...)

Also you can eat home if you have a girlfriend who can cook (current ones both can cook), and there's a bottle in a fridge at home.

Korean translation for new dialogues will be added later (one dialogue miss Spanish and Brazil translation as well now).

notes.title: Special outfit for girls
notes.content: Added special outfit for girls living in the oyabun's house.

notes.title: New feature added: Fishermen club
notes.content: You will be invited to fishermen club if you catch enough different fish.

notes.title: Kids on the playground
notes.content: Some kids were added to the playground.

notes.title: New feature added: Searching trash cans
notes.content: You can now search large trash cans for goodies. You have to fall low, of course, to gain this ability.

notes.title: New achievement is added: Drunken Master
notes.content: Prove your kung-fu to every passerby.

notes.title: Sitting with your girlfriend
notes.content: You can now sit with your girlfriend. Also controls for kissing were changed, cause it messed up with other controls. Now you have to hold action button and press the other one to kiss a girl (the same you do when you punch men).

notes.title: French localization is live
notes.content: French localization is done.

notes.title: New feature added: Buying bottles at bars
notes.content: You can now buy a bottle in a bar, walk and drink it. You can also throw a bottle into an enemy and passersby.

notes.title: New feature added: Punching male passerby
notes.content: You can now punch any male passerby when you drunk (with almost no penalty for now, but more mechanics in the works...)

notes.title: New feature added: Skippable dialogues
notes.content:
You can skip a scene if you have seen it already (keep in mind that since it's just implemented, the game doesn't know what you have seen up to this date). Some scenes are unskippable (scenes with choices mostly).

If a scene is skippable you'll see the icon at the top right corner.

notes.title: Saving at the map area only
notes.content: The game auto saves only at the map area only now (and when you enter poker or roulette mini-game). You'll see a message when it happens.

notes.title: New feature added: Riding girlfriends on bicycles on city streets
notes.content: You can ride your girlfriend on a bicycle. Bicycles were added to most city streets, more to come in the upcoming days.

notes.title: New feature added: Dancing with girlfriends
notes.content: You can dance with your woman at disco.

notes.title: New feature added: Skipping beginning scenes on the 2nd playthrough
notes.content: You can skip beginning scenes up to 2nd week on your 2nd playthrough, if you have cleared battle tutorial.

notes.title: New feature added: Starting a new game at any moment on the title screen
notes.content: You can now start a new game at any moment on the title screen.

notes.title: “Fading Afternoon” will release at Sep.14,Initial price 17.99$
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847328/d47f275830e2b791262fa731e8159955a620ebd2.png[/img]

Developed by yeo and published by Indieark, side-scrolling game "Fading Afternoon" will be released at 7 pm(PDT) on Sep.14! The price will be 19.99$, and you will also enjoy a 10% discount when it is released. You can play this latest game for only 17.99$!

"Fading Afternoon" tells the story of a middle-aged gangster, Seiji Maruyama, who returns to the gang after being released from prison. Before being imprisoned, Maruyama was an important force in the gang, but after a long prison life, Maruyama is getting old. After being released from prison, Maruyama also stood at the crossroads of his life. Going back to the gangsters to fight bloody for the honor of the past? Or change your mind and live an ordinary life? It all depends on your choice...

This game will start a series of stories around the protagonist-Maruyama Seiji. You can start a war with other gangs and regain your territory by fighting other gangs, or you can just hang out on the street, soak in hot springs, get massages, and be a fisherman. The game will enter different endings based on your actions and choices. You will witness with your own eyes what kind of path the aging Maruyama will take.
  This game will be released at 7 pm on Sep.14(PDT), so stay tuned!

notes.title: IndieArk and yeo officially announced the cooperation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847328/13f4947e4c000947e8b07bcae33fdf4ed825f20b.jpg[/img]

Hello friends! Thank you so much for your support. Today, we are very happy to announce that we have officially cooperated with the the developer - yeo!

Yeo is known for his work and his thought-provoking plots. "The friends of Ringo Ishikawa" caused a wave of enthusiasm in the world is his work.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/846110/The_friends_of_Ringo_Ishikawa/
Today, yeo will bring his brand new game "Fading Afternoon" to Steam!

IndieArk will serve as the publisher of "Fading Afternoon", and will let more Chinese players know about and lile "Fading Afternoon". At the same time, they will assist us in the Chinese localization of the game, marketing promotion, platform docking, community liaison, etc., to help the game enter the field of vision of more players in a better state.
Shortly, we will also announce relevant announcements about the game's release information. Interested players, please continue to follow us! To get more news about the game, please pay attention to Indieark's twitter and yeo's twitter!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hi.

We've finished all battle animations (maybe I'll add some more later though) and I made "Rumble mode" which will be opened after the first playthrough. It's more or less standard Survival mode where you can choose a location, weather, music and type of enemies you wanna fight (I'll think about Leaderboard, but that's not certain).

[previewyoutube=9SlqtjWWCVE;full][/previewyoutube]

I wrote almost all criminal routes (with dialogues) for the game and now I am working on cutscenes and peaceful routes. I want to add more freedom to some scenes, so they will  be only half-scripted. Like in this scene where you can pass by or help a fellow from your family. It's also up to you whether you will comfort him after the beating or not.

[previewyoutube=kAgcphzl7w0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
Hi.

I was thinking about running some kind of a devlog somewhere, and maybe Steam is the best place, cause all players will be here after all.

But I'm not sure if players even read devlogs here at Steam.

Anyway. This time I want to give players more freedom with interacting with the game's world, so your actions will matter, and you'll receive different endings. I'm not sure how complex it will be, but you already can kill your own boss anytime.
